fusions.name: Red Tape
fusions.desc: Lashes a length of filing ribbon into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds, slowing its attacks.

fusions.name: Unspooled Chronicle
fusions.desc: Unrolls a woven scroll across a cone 6 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it. The damage ignores resistances, and each enemy hit is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Dressing
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Its healing rises 1% for each 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Rag-Stock Cushion
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
